description: This file defines an abstract base class 'NodeTestCase' for testing Twig nodes within the Twig templating engine. It provides setup methods, test execution helpers, and deprecation warnings, facilitating unit testing of Twig node compilation processes.

classes.name: NodeTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit testing Twig Node objects, providing setup and assertion methods, as well as deprecation handling.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an array of test cases for node compilation testing.

methods.name: provideTests
methods.description: Provides test data for testing node compilation. It is designed to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: testCompile
methods.description: Runs a test to compile a node and compare the output to expected source.

methods.name: assertNodeCompilation
methods.description: Asserts that compiling a node produces expected source code, with optional pattern matching.

methods.name: getCompiler
methods.description: Creates and returns a Compiler object, optionally with a specific environment.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the current Twig Environment, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a new Twig Environment with an ArrayLoader.

methods.name: getVariableGetter
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving variable getter code; use createVariableGetter instead.

methods.name: createVariableGetter
methods.description: Generates PHP code for retrieving a variable from the Twig context.

methods.name: getAttributeGetter
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving attribute getter code; use createAttributeGetter instead.

methods.name: createAttributeGetter
methods.description: Returns PHP code for fetching attributes in Twig nodes.

methods.name: checkDataProvider
methods.description: A method annotated to run before all tests; verifies which 'getTests' method is implemented and issues deprecation warnings accordingly.
